description: Scrape tech company profiles from BuiltIn.com — get company info, industries, headcount, benefits, and open jobs.

companyUrls.description: BuiltIn company URLs (e.g. `https://builtin.com/company/stripe`) or company names (e.g. `Stripe`). Slugs like `stripe` also accepted.
companyUrls.title: Company URLs or names (mode=byCompany)

includeProfile.description: If true, fetch each company's full profile page for additional details. Slower but more complete.
includeProfile.title: Fetch full company profile

location.description: Filter companies by US city/market. Leave empty for all US companies. Note: `national` uses the same builtin.com listing as "All US" (BuiltIn has no separate national-remote listing) — combine with `officeType: remote` to get remote-only companies.
enumTitles: National (same listing as All US — builtin.com)
location.title: Location (mode=browse)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on total records emitted.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to scrape. `browse` lists companies from the BuiltIn directory. `byCompany` fetches specific company profiles by name or BuiltIn URL.
enumTitles: Browse — list companies from BuiltIn directory
By Company — fetch specific company profiles
mode.title: Mode

title: BuiltIn Scraper Input
